summary: fix(settings): handle known server errors in passkey sign-in
description:
Because:
- Passkey sign-in showed the generic error banner for throttled and blocked requests.
- Known passkey errnos went to Sentry and Glean as unexpected.

This commit:
- Shows the localized banner for errno 114 and 125 in usePasskeySignIn.
- Reports named Glean reasons for 114, 125, 227 and 238, with no Sentry call.
- Adds the four reasons to PasskeySignInGleanReason and fxa-ui-metrics.yaml.
- Adds unit cases and a functional test for the WAF 429 and 406 banners.

Closes FXA-14764
